title: 第十三章 相逢
slug: 剑来全本免费-剑来最新章节列表
content_zh:
锦衣少年在冷峻少女七八步距离外，停下身形，眼神真诚道：“我叫高稹，是大隋弋阳郡人氏。吴爷爷若有得罪之处，我愿意向姑娘道歉和补偿。”
高大老人站在锦衣少年身后，心情复杂。所谓的大隋弋阳郡高氏子弟，其实不过是个含蓄说法罢了。大隋国祚一千二百年，坐龙椅的人都姓高，太祖皇帝便是龙兴于弋阳郡。
少女对此无动于衷，抬起双手系紧绷带，对老人说道：“若是在外边，面对一位极有可能已经‘御风远游’的武道大宗师，我绝非对手。但是此时此刻，我只要假借飞剑，你必死无疑。”
高大老人冷笑道：“只要那名刺客事先知晓你的杀手锏，以他那副小宗师巅峰的体魄，只要护住要害，任你刺穿十剑又如何？他尚且如此，更何况我比他高出两个境界，其中一道门槛还被视为武道天堑。小姑娘，我不知道你哪来的底气，才说得出来‘必死无疑’四个字。”
少女皱了皱眉头，一只手悄然扶住刀柄，“我是很怕麻烦的人，更讨厌跟人吵架，不然我们出手试试看真假？谁赢了谁有道理，如何？”
极少有机会被人威胁的老人有些恼火。如果不是身处于这个神憎鬼厌的诡谲地方，就少女这般修为的修为，任她再天赋异禀，老人一只手也能碾压虐杀十个。退一步说，如果不是重任在身，需要照顾被大隋举国寄予厚望的少年殿下，老人哪怕拼着被此处自行循环的大道镇压重伤，也要好好教训一下不知天高地厚的少女，初生牛犊不怕虎，勇气可嘉，仅此而已，可不意味着猛虎就不会把牛犊吃得一干二净。
自称高稹的锦衣少年赶紧打圆场道：“如果姑娘一定要追究，我愿意拿出此物作为弥补。”
高稹低头以表诚意，只求姑娘不要追究先前吴爷爷的无心冒犯，他毕竟是出于忠义，并无害人之心。”
眉发皆白的高大老宦官顿时悚然，单膝下跪，惶恐不安道：“殿下不可！老奴何等腌臜，此方玉玺却是殿下机缘所在，是世间罕有的纯粹宝物，甚至能够承载民间香火，两者如何能够相提并论，殿下这是要活活逼死老奴啊！”
出身天潢贵胄的高姓少年脸色僵硬。
少女好似有些不耐烦，讥讽笑道：“偏居一隅的井底之蛙，倒是人人都喜欢敝帚自珍。将那方玉玺收回去吧，我一直很喜欢一句话，叫君子不夺人所好。”
少女行事干脆利落，转身就走。
锦衣少年如释重负，“起来吧，吴爷爷，跪着多不像话。我大隋十二位大貂寺，素来只跪帝王，这要是被六科言官或是礼部的人瞧见，拿出来说事，咱们俩都要倒霉。行了，这趟小镇之行，我承蒙祖宗庇护，圆满完成，我们就不要横生枝节了，速速离开此地，而且在外头跟自己人接应后，也不可掉以轻心，要知道大骊王朝内的六大柱国，其中袁、曹两家虽是对立阵营，但是很不凑巧，这两根大骊砥柱，与我们大隋高氏有不共戴天之仇，一旦吴爷爷你在此有了意外，战力受损，我很难安然无恙地返回大隋。”
老人点点头，缓缓起身，“老奴知晓事情的轻重，缓急。”
当老人说到“急”这个字眼的时候，帷帽少女已经走出去二十余步。
锦衣少年身边拂过一阵清风，鬓角发丝和锦衣袍袖都被吹得飘荡起来。
原来身边这位在大隋权柄煊赫的老人，根本就没有放过少女的心思，此时已经一冲而去，前三步重重踩踏在小巷地面上，声响沉闷，直透地面底下一丈有余，第四步的时候，老人已经高高跃起，一拳砸向少女后背心。
帷帽少女腰肢猛然拧转，以左脚脚尖为支撑点，右手拔刀出鞘，小巷当中出现一抹比阳光更耀眼的雪白光辉。
高大老人以压顶之势扑杀而至，一拳直直砸在刀锋上，手背竟然只被锋芒气盛的刃口割出一条血痕，老宦官双脚轰然落地后，继续前冲，推得持刀少女一直向后倒退，老人随即轻描淡写伸出一掌，看似缓慢从容，实则闪电一般推在了少女额头，老人刚要加重力道，一掌碎裂这颗隐藏在帷帽下的脑袋，连忙脚步挪动，身形横移一尺，扑哧一声，低头一看，有利器从后背穿透自己右边胸口，是剑尖。

content_en:
The boy in brocade clothes stopped seven or eight steps away from the stern girl, and said with sincerity in his eyes: "My name is Gao Zhen, and I am from Yiyang County in the Sui Dynasty. If Grandpa Wu has offended me in any way, I am willing to apologize and make amends to the girl."
The tall old man stood behind the young man in brocade clothes with mixed emotions. The so-called descendants of the Gao family in Yiyang County of the Great Sui Dynasty are actually just an implicit statement. During the 1,200th year of the reign of Emperor Zuo of the Sui Dynasty, the people who sat on the Dragon Throne all had the surname Gao. Emperor Taizu was the Dragon Xing in Yiyang County.
The girl was indifferent to this, raised her hands to tie the bandage tightly, and said to the old man: "If I were to face a martial arts master outside who was very likely to have traveled far away from home, I would be no match. But at this moment, if I just use the flying sword under the guise, you will definitely die."
The tall old man sneered: "As long as that assassin knows your trump card in advance, with his peak body of a young master, what if he can protect his vital points and let you pierce ten swords? He is like this, not to mention that I am two realms higher than him, and one of the thresholds is considered a natural chasm in martial arts. Little girl, I don't know where you got the confidence to say the words 'Death is certain'."
The girl frowned and quietly held the handle of the knife with one hand, "I'm a person who is very afraid of trouble, and I hate quarrels with others. How about we give it a try and see what's true? Who wins and who makes sense? How about that?"
The old man, who rarely had the chance to be threatened, was a little annoyed. If we weren't in this weird place where gods and ghosts hated us, with the girl's level of cultivation, no matter how talented she was, the old man could crush and kill ten of them with one hand. To take a step back, if it were not for the heavy responsibility and the need to take care of His Highness, a young man who had high hopes from the whole country of the Sui Dynasty, even if the old man was seriously injured by the self-circulating avenue here, he would still have to teach the young girl who does not know the heights of the world a lesson. A newborn calf is not afraid of tigers, and its courage is commendable. That is all, but it does not mean that the tiger will not eat the calf completely.
The young man in Jinyi, who called himself Gao Zhen, quickly smoothed things over and said, "If the girl must pursue the case, I am willing to take out this thing as compensation."
Gao Zhen lowered his head to show his sincerity, and only asked the girl not to pursue Grandpa Wu's unintentional offense before. After all, he was out of loyalty and had no intention of harming anyone. "
The tall old eunuch with white eyebrows suddenly became horrified, knelt down on one knee, and said in fear: "No, Your Highness! How dirty the old slave is, but this square jade seal is your highness' chance. It is a rare pure treasure in the world, and can even carry folk incense. How can the two be compared? Your highness is going to force the old slave to death! "
The young man surnamed Gao, who was born in a noble family in Tianhuang, had a stiff face.
The girl seemed a little impatient, and said with a sarcastic smile: "I am a frog in a well, but everyone likes to keep their brooms to themselves. Take that square jade seal back. I have always liked a saying that says a gentleman should not take what others like. "
The girl acted crisply and neatly, turned around and left.
The young man in brocade clothes was relieved and said, "Get up, Grandpa Wu, it's shameful to kneel down. I, the twelve Great Diao Temples of the Sui Dynasty, have always only knelt down to the emperor. If this is seen by the Liu Ke Yan Guan or the people from the Ministry of Rites, and they are brought up to argue, we will both be in trouble. Okay, this trip to the small town has been successfully completed thanks to the protection of my ancestors. Let’s not create any complications and leave this place quickly. Moreover, after meeting with our own people outside, we must not take it lightly. We must know the six pillar countries in the Great Li Dynasty. Among them, Yuan and Cao are in opposing camps, but unfortunately, these two pillars have a sworn hatred with our Gao family in the Sui Dynasty. Once you, Grandpa Wu, have an accident here and your combat power is damaged, it will be difficult for me to return to the Sui Dynasty unharmed. "
The old man nodded and stood up slowly, "I know the seriousness and urgency of the matter. "
When the old man said the word "urgent", the girl in the curtain hat had already walked out more than twenty steps.
A breeze blew past the young man in brocade clothes, causing the hair on his temples and the sleeves of his brocade robe to flutter.
It turns out that this guy next to me is in collegeThe powerful old man in Sui Dynasty did not let the girl go at all. He rushed away at this time. The first three steps were heavily stomped on the alley ground. The sound was dull and penetrated more than a foot into the ground. On the fourth step, the old man had already jumped high and punched the girl's back vest.
The girl in the curtain hat suddenly twisted her waist, using the toes of her left foot as a support point, she drew the sword out of its sheath with her right hand, and a snow-white light that was more dazzling than the sun appeared in the alley.
The tall old man came at him with overwhelming force, and punched the blade directly. The back of his hand was cut with a bloody mark by the sharp blade. After the old eunuch's feet landed with a bang, he continued to rush forward, pushing the girl holding the knife back. The old man then lightly stretched out his palm and looked. It seemed to be slow and calm, but in reality he pushed the girl's forehead like lightning. Just as the old man was about to apply more force, he smashed the head hidden under the curtain with his palm. He quickly moved his steps, moved one foot sideways, made a thud, looked down, and saw a sharp weapon penetrating his right chest from the back, which was the tip of the sword.
